## Non-negotiables (full set in fe-coding + ai/reactnative)

- `router.navigate` for user-triggered navigation (spam-tap safe); `push` only for intentional duplicates.
- StyleSheet + theme tokens, no inline hex; safe-area aware layouts.
- Secrets/tokens in secure storage, never AsyncStorage.
- Every fetch has loading, empty, error and offline-tolerant states.
- Platform differences (`Platform.OS`, permissions) handled explicitly — say what you could not test on a device.
